{{Youmay|the explosive|the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode named "[[Warhead (episode)|Warhead]]"}}
'''Warhead''' referred to the explosive carried by projectile weapons designed to detonate on impact with or proximity to a given target, such as the [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] or [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]]. Other types included the advanced torpedo, [[Missile/Legends|missile]], advanced missile, and [[Mag-pulse warhead|mag pulse]]. The word was also used as a generic term for such ordnance. Warhead Launchers were found on the [[Separatist super-tank prototype/Legends|super tank]] during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]].

Concussion weapons utilized [[armor-piercing warhead]]s, while proton torpedoes were armed with a [[proton-scattering energy warhead]].<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
